messages:
Priya: Quick check — reservations for the Q3 dedicated pool. We've had a couple customers ask to shift committed capacity from pool-a to pool-b. Need confirmation on who owns the reassign and whether we can make 48 GPUs available by 2026-04-15. @Tom @Maya any blockers? :eyes:

Tom: Short update — blocked on rack power mapping for the target racks, infra needs to confirm sequencing. ETA end of day for the mapping doc.

Maya: I updated the inventory sheet: https://docs.internal/teams/reservations (row resv-2026-07). I can own the reservation move if infra confirms cable kits. @Li can you confirm kit availability for west-1 cluster?

Li: Cable kits are delayed about 3 days from the vendor, but we have 24 spare kits in staging that we can redeploy if ops approves reuse. ops-bot: can you flag procurement?

ops-bot: Incident created #INC-4529 — cable-kit procurement delay. Procurement@redwood notified.

Alex: If we reuse staging kits we need to verify firmware parity before swapping. Please add a firmware check step to the handoff checklist. Quick command we use: 
```bash
./tools/check_fw.sh --nodes ng-0[01-24] --expect 1.4.2
```

Maya: Done — added checklist item and the script to the PR: https://git.internal/repo/pull/458. Can someone review the PR? @Priya 

Priya: Reviewing now. Also: clarify whether this is a soft reservation move (no customer downtime) or if we need a maintenance window. Customers need a heads-up either way.

Tom: This will be a soft move with fallback. Plan: route new allocations to pool-b and keep pool-a live until final cutover; no planned downtime. We'll include fallback policy in the ops runbook.

Li: Given the kit delay, plan is reuse + firmware check. I'll own running fw checks across ng-01..24. ETA ~48h to complete checks and report.

Maya: Can we set a canary for Mon 2026-04-13 09:00 PT? If firmware looks good we flip a small set of allocations. @Priya can you confirm with CS to schedule the canary?

Priya: Will confirm with Customer Success and post back here by EOD. :thumbsup:

Alex: FYI I updated the reservations sheet (row resv-2026-07) to reflect new owners (Maya / Li) and tentative canary date. No other blockers noted on my side.

Maya: Thanks — will follow up after Li posts fw results.

Tom: Ping for infra mapping doc when ready, I'll take the sequencing.

Priya: Looping in CS once we have final canary time. Leaving a note here for audit: resv-2026-07 change log will be saved to the ticket.

Alex: +1.
